what_it_does.name: google-agents-cli-adk-code
what_it_does.summary: Reference documents for writing agent code with ADK (Agent Development Kit) in Python and Go. Cheatsheets cover agent types, tools, callbacks, plugins, state, memory, artifacts, multi-agent orchestration, the graph Workflow API and live voice agents, and a topic index maps each capability to a recipe in google/adk-recipes to clone and study. The result is agent code written into a project already scaffolded with agents-cli. Use it when the user wants to write agent code, add a tool, create a callback or define an agent with ADK, not for scaffolding or deployment.
tasks: write ADK agents, tools and callbacks in Python or Go
orchestrate multi-agent systems with sequential, parallel and loop agents
build graph workflows with routing, fan-out, fan-in and human-in-the-loop
build live voice and video agents with run_live
find and study the reference recipe for a capability
look up ADK docs through the llms.txt index or the installed package
what_it_does.author_description: This skill should be used when the user wants to "write agent code", "build an agent with ADK", "add a tool", "create a callback", "define an agent", "use state management" — in a project that needs ADK (Agent Development Kit) API patterns and code examples. It provides a quick reference for agent types, tool definitions, orchestration patterns, callbacks, state management, the graph Workflow API, and reference recipes to study. Do NOT use for scaffolding (use google-agents-cli-scaffold) or deployment (use google-agents-cli-deploy).

risks.risk: Instructions hidden in a cloned recipe AGENTS.md or a fetched docs page reach the agent, since these are read before implementing, and contrib recipes are not curated.
A directory already at /tmp/adk-recipes is read as the recipes without a fresh clone, so content placed there by another process reaches the agent.

limitations: The Python Workflow API requires google-adk 2.0.0 or later and Python 3.11 or later.
Using output_schema disables tool calling and delegation.
google_search is model-internal grounding, and mixing it with function tools disables automatic function calling for all tools.
Live agents cannot be served over A2A or published to Gemini, and Live models reject text output.
ManagedAgent requires ADK 2.4.0 or later, and client-side tools raise NotImplementedError.
ADK Go has no OpenAPI toolset.
The Go reference reflects google.golang.org/adk/v2 v2.1.0, so a symbol can be missing in another version.
The eleven core Python recipes are the complete set, other capabilities need contrib/ or own code.
InMemoryMemoryService memories do not persist across restarts.
Pub/Sub and Eventarc have a 10-minute processing limit.
